event.title: Almería Hosts 36th Annual Vintage Car Rally Celebrating Motoring History
event.canonical_title: Almería Hosts 36th Annual Vintage Car Rally Celebrating Motoring History
event.summary: Approximately 40 vintage and classic cars participated in the 36th annual rally in Almería, Spain. The event featured vehicles from various eras, including a rare 1905 Vermorel and a DeLorean, highlighting over a century of automotive history.
